description_en: Provides bank card element verification (two-element, three-element, and four-element) API operations
description_zh: 银行卡要素（银行卡二要素、银行卡三要素和银行卡四要素）API接口
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl bank-meta-verify-intl --product-code BANK_CARD_N_META --param-type normal --verify-mode VERIFY_BANK_CARD --product-type BANK_CARD_4_META --bank-card '●_明文：12345678000000_●_密文：_12345678f8ee21920e37807b43e7e912ab829b6e' --user-name '张0' --identity-type 01 --identify-num '●_明文：429001000000008211_●_密文：_42900132fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec98211' --mobile '●_明文：18600002055_●_密文：_849169cd3b20621c1c78bd61a11a4fc2' --region cn-hangzhou
name: BankMetaVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:
- normal: no encryption
- md5: MD5 encryption

Important:

- All encrypted parameter values must be 32-character lowercase MD5 strings.
- Different MD5 tools may produce different ciphertext. If the API call succeeds before encryption but fails after encryption, try a different MD5 tool
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式：
- normal：不加密
- md5：md5加密

重要:

- 所有参数的密文均取32位小写MD5字符串形式。
- 不同MD5工具得出的密文可能不同，如果加密前接口可以调通但加密后不行，请尝试更换MD5工具
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en: VERIFY_BANK_CARD: bank card authentication mode. Indicates whether the provided bank card number matches the user's real name, ID card number, and phone number
parameters.help_zh: VERIFY_BANK_CARD：银行卡认证模式。表示将传入的银行卡号和用户的真实姓名、身份证号，手机号是否匹配
parameters.name: verify_mode

parameters.help_en:
The product type to call. Valid values:

- BANK_CARD_2_META: Bank card number + name verification.
- BANK_CARD_3_META: Bank card number + name + ID card number verification.
- BANK_CARD_4_META: Bank card number + name + ID card number + phone number verification
parameters.help_zh:
调用产品类型：

- BANK_CARD_2_META：银⾏卡号+姓名核验。
- BANK_CARD_3_META：银⾏卡号+姓名+身份证号核验。
- BANK_CARD_4_META：银⾏卡号+姓名+身份证号+⼿机号核验
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The bank card number.

- If paramType is set to normal, enter the bank card number in plaintext.
- If paramType is set to md5, provide the plaintext of all digits except the last 6 digits + the MD5 value (32-character lowercase) of the last 6 digits
parameters.help_zh:
银行卡号。

- 当paramType取值normal时，输入银行卡号明文。
- 当paramType取值md5时，卡号除最后6位其他部分明文+最后6位md5值（32位小写）
parameters.name: bank_card

parameters.help_en:
The name.

- If paramType is set to normal, enter the name in plaintext.
- If paramType is set to md5, provide the MD5-encrypted first character of the name (32-character lowercase MD5) + the plaintext of the remaining characters
parameters.help_zh:
姓名。

- 当paramType取值normal时，输入姓名明文。
- 当paramType取值md5时，姓名第一个字MD5加密（32位小写MD5）+ 姓名其他部分明文
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The ID document type. If left empty, the default value is ID card. For other document types, refer to the table below
parameters.help_zh: 证件类型（传空值默认为身份证，其他证件类型详见下表）
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID document number.
- If paramType is set to normal, enter the ID document number in plaintext.
- If paramType is set to md5:
    - For ID cards: the first 6 digits (plaintext) + date of birth (ciphertext) + the last 4 digits (plaintext).
    - For other documents: the last 2 characters are MD5-encrypted.

Important:
This parameter is required when ProductType is set to one of the following values:
- BANK_CARD_3_META
- BANK_CARD_4_META
parameters.help_zh:
证件号：
- paramType 传 normal 时：传入证件号明文。
- paramType 传 md5 时：
    - 身份证号前6位（明文）+出生年月日（密文）+身份证号后4位（明文）。
    - 其他证件最后两位MD5加密。

重要
ProductType为以下取值时，此项必选。
- BANK_CARD_3_META
- BANK_CARD_4_META
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The phone number.
- If paramType is set to normal, enter the phone number in plaintext.
- If paramType is set to md5, enter the phone number in ciphertext.

Important:

- This parameter is required when ProductType is set to BANK_CARD_4_META
parameters.help_zh:
手机号：
- paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。
- paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文。

重要

- ProductType = BANK_CARD_4_META时，此项必选
parameters.name: mobile
